title: CV of Nadia Rahman
summary: Machine Learning Engineer - LLM apps, RAG and NLP; 7 years; employers: Tessellate Analytics, Northwind Telecom, Independent (freelance)

title: Churn uplift model for prepaid subscribers
summary: I built a dual‑model system that identified prepaid customers most likely to respond to a retention incentive and scored them weekly, and it reduced churn in the targeted group by 11% while cutting offer spend by 30%.

title: Intent classification for call-centre transcripts
summary: I built an intent classification system for Northwind Telecom’s call‑centre transcripts, fine‑tuning a large language model on 40 k labelled summaries. The solution achieved a macro‑F1 of 0.87 across 14 intents and halved routing errors.

title: Fixing a broken WordPress plugin for a friend's travel blog
summary: I repaired a malfunctioning WordPress plugin for a travel blog, restoring the site’s functionality. The website was back online within an afternoon, allowing the client to resume publishing content without further disruption.

title: Production pipeline for a credit-scoring model
summary: I built an automated weekly credit‑scoring pipeline for Finchly that reduced release cadence and added early drift detection. The system now releases models with a single click, flags two drift incidents early and runs without manual intervention.

title: Daily demand forecast for a bakery chain
summary: I built a daily demand forecasting model for a nine‑store bakery chain using time‑series methods, and the solution reduced waste by 12%.

title: Cleaning a messy survey dataset for a PhD researcher
summary: I built a single tidy table from eighteen raw survey files for a PhD researcher, and produced a concise data dictionary. The cleaned dataset is now ready for statistical analysis and reproducibility.

title: Reviewing machine-translated Urdu product copy
summary: I reviewed and corrected 1,200 machine‑translated Urdu product strings for an e‑commerce client. The corrected copy improved customer comprehension and reduced return queries.

title: Automatic support-ticket routing
summary: I built an automatic ticket‑routing system that classifies incoming support requests and directs them to the appropriate team, achieving 72% automatic routing. This reduced first‑response time by 40% for Quillstack’s helpdesk platform.

title: CV parsing for an HR start-up
summary: I built a CV parsing pipeline that extracts key candidate information using named entity recognition and rule‑based extraction, achieving 91% field accuracy on a test set of 500 CVs. The solution was delivered to an HR‑tech start‑up in September 2022 and integrated into their recruitment workflow.

title: Guest review sentiment dashboard
summary: I built a weekly sentiment dashboard that aggregates guest reviews for fourteen hotels, and delivered concise sentiment reports each week. The system automated the extraction, classification and visualisation of sentiment trends, enabling the client to act on guest feedback promptly.

title: Invoice and bill-of-lading field extraction
summary: I built an automated extraction pipeline that reads invoices and bills of lading, pulls 18 key data points with a language model and validates them against a schema, and routes low‑confidence cases to operators. The system now processes 9,000 documents a month, cutting manual keying effort by 80%.

title: Cold-start recommendations for a reading app
summary: I built a cold‑start recommender system using matrix factorisation for a media reading app, and the day‑one click‑through rate rose by 9%. The solution integrated smoothly with their existing pipeline and required minimal ongoing tuning.

title: Contract question-answering assistant with an evaluation harness
summary: I built a contract‑question answering assistant that retrieves relevant clauses and supplies answers graded against a lawyer‑crafted key, raising answer accuracy from 61 % to 86 %. The system now provides citations from source clauses with virtually no unsupported references.

title: Surface-defect image classifier
summary: I built a computer‑vision classifier to detect surface defects on manufactured parts, achieving a recall of 0.94 for cracked items. The model replaced a manual spot‑check step, cutting inspection time by half.

title: Voice-of-customer topic mining on product reviews
summary: I built an interactive topic‑mining system for Brightcart’s product reviews and identified three recurring defects, which reduced returns on the affected SKUs by six percent.

title: FAQ chatbot for a small online store
summary: I built a FAQ chatbot for a small e‑commerce store using embeddings and a lightweight chat interface. The bot now resolves about 60 % of customer queries without staff intervention.

title: Prompt and output audit for a marketing copy generator
summary: I audited the prompts and outputs of a SaaS marketing copy generator and refined its prompt set, reducing off‑brand copies from 20 % to 4 %. The client now receives consistently on‑brand text with minimal manual correction.

title: LLM lead-qualification agent inside a real-estate CRM
summary: I built an autonomous lead‑qualification assistant that converses via SMS and records vetted prospects in the CRM, cutting qualification time from two days to three hours and freeing about six hours per week for each agent.

title: Batch transcription and chaptering for a podcast network
summary: I built an automated batch transcription and chaptering pipeline for a podcast network’s back‑catalogue, and delivered 400 episodes fully transcribed and chaptered within a week.

title: docparse-lite
summary: The repository extracts structured data from PDF invoices and bill‑of‑lading documents using OCR and a language model, validates each field against a Pydantic schema and routes low‑confidence results to a manual review queue. It processes batches of PDFs and outputs a CSV of successfully extracted records.

title: lead-agent
summary: A Python package implements an LLM‑driven lead‑qualification agent that processes inbound real‑estate enquiries, gathers missing information via SMS, and writes a qualified lead to a PostgreSQL‑backed CRM after human approval. The workflow is orchestrated with LangGraph and integrates Twilio for messaging.

title: rag-eval-kit
summary: A FastAPI service that answers contract questions by retrieving relevant clauses using blended BM25 and vector search, then re‑ranking them with a cross‑encoder before returning the top answer with a citation. An accompanying pytest suite evaluates the system against a 120‑question answer key, reporting accuracy improvements.

title: scoring-service
summary:
A FastAPI service that serves versioned credit‑scoring predictions, tracks model runs with MLflow and raises alerts when input data drifts from the training distribution.  
The service can promote a new model version with a single API call and logs drift metrics using Evidently.

title: ticket-router
summary: A lightweight ticket‑routing service that classifies incoming support tickets with a distilled transformer model and dispatches them to appropriate queues. The system runs inference via ONNX Runtime in Celery workers and stores routing results in Redis.
